newsitem.title: UK: Britain sets closing date for 17th licensing round.
newsitem.headline: Britain sets closing date for 17th licensing round.

text.p: The closing date for Britain's seventeenth offshore oil and gas licensing round has been set for March 25, a spokesman for the U.K.'s Department of Trade and Industry said on Monday.

The deadline for applications falls 90 days after formal notice offering acreage in frontier areas of the U.K. Continental Shelf was published in the Official Journal of the European Communities on December 24, three days later than expected.
Most of the tranches on offer are southwest of the discoveries in the West of Shetland area and in the Rockall Trough, east of Rockall.
"We are, of course, asking companies to make their applications earlier if they are able," said the spokesman.
